prompt: Cinematic aerial shot, a drone glides slowly over a fog-shrouded Shanghai Bund, the camera diving down from the tops of the three Lujiazui skyscrapers in Pudong and sweeping across the fine glittering ripples of the Huangpu River. Golden morning sunlight pierces the thin mist, and a cargo ship crosses the river leaving a white wake. In the distance the Oriental Pearl Tower fades in and out of the morning haze. An extreme wide shot pushes gradually into a medium shot.

Documentary photography style, the Shibuya crossing in Tokyo during a downpour, hundreds of pedestrians hurry across the zebra stripes under umbrellas of every color. Rain refracts the neon light into iridescent speckles, and puddles on the ground mirror the reflections. A red taxi rolls slowly through the intersection, its wheels throwing up spray. The camera looks down from above and slowly descends to the crowd's eye level. A wide shot dissolves into a medium shot.

Cinematic long take, the camera pushes slowly along a narrow Venetian canal as a black gondola glides quietly over the emerald water. The gondolier, in a striped shirt, stands at the stern and drives the pole hard, the hull rocking gently. Ivy climbs the ancient brick walls on both sides, and sunlight falls through the gaps between the buildings in shafts. Ripples shimmer with golden light. Medium tracking shot.

IMAX-scale imagery, Times Square in New York during a blizzard, enormous LED billboards flickering through the driving snow. Pedestrians pull their coats tight and walk head-down; a delivery rider in a yellow raincoat pushes his bicycle through with difficulty. Cars crawl along the snow-covered street, headlights haloing in the snowy mist. The camera pans slowly to take in the whole scene.

Cinematic golden-hour light, the Roman Colosseum at sunset, golden afterglow washing over the ancient stone walls. A flock of pigeons bursts out from between the arches and wheels through an orange-red sky. Tourists stroll and take photographs across the plaza, their long shadows stretching over the flagstones. The camera pulls slowly from a close view of the weathered stone texture out to a wide shot. Warm-toned documentary film style.

Cyberpunk cinematic style, Temple Street in Hong Kong at night, dense neon signs stacked and flashing. Steam rises from the street-side food stalls as a young man in sunglasses walks through the crowd toward the camera. The wet ground reflects red and blue neon, and a double-decker bus rolls past in the distance. Low-angle camera tilts up and slowly retreats. Dark, high-contrast imagery.

Epic aerial shot, Angkor Wat in the golden light of dawn, the camera pushing slowly from above the jungle canopy toward the temple spires. Morning mist drifts across the moat, and the mirror-still water holds the temple's complete silhouette. A few egrets lift off the surface and sweep across the frame. The ancient stone towers glow warm amber in the sun. An extreme wide aerial shot descends and closes in.

Documentary film style, the Grand Bazaar of Istanbul at dawn, vendors pushing carts and busily setting out their goods. Multicolored Turkish lanterns hang beneath the vaulted ceiling, scattering dappled light. An orange cat leaps down from a spice stall, crosses the corridor and vanishes around a corner. The air seems thick with the smell of spices. Stabilized camera tracking the cat. Medium shot.

Cinematic time-lapse texture, the Dubai skyline from sunset into night, the sun sinking into the desert behind the Burj Khalifa. The sky shifts from gold-orange to deep blue as the city's lights come up like a river of stars. Traffic on the highway forms continuous ribbons of light winding through the city. The silhouette of Palm Island emerges in the dusk. Ultra-wide locked-off wide shot.

Black-and-white film stock texture, Montmartre in Paris after rain, wet cobblestones reflecting the faint glow of the street lamps. A woman with an umbrella climbs the steps alone, her heels echoing off the stone. In the distance the Sacré-Cœur is dimly visible through the haze. The image carries pronounced film grain. Locked-off camera; the figure walks from far away toward the lens.

National Geographic documentary style, the African savanna at golden hour, a male lion tossing his mane as he paces through the golden grass. His musculature is sharply defined, amber eyes fixed ahead, every step carrying an unhurried power. Behind him stands the silhouette of a lone acacia, the sunset staining the sky deep orange. The camera tracks laterally alongside him. Medium close-up.

Underwater documentary cinematography, a humpback whale rises slowly through the deep blue with her calf. The mother's enormous pectoral fins stir the water gently while the calf swims pressed against her side. Sunlight streams down from the surface in shafts, and bubbles drift up from the whale's mouth. Small fish scatter in all directions around them. The camera orbits slowly from the side. Medium shot.

BBC nature documentary texture, the Amazon rainforest just before a storm, a brilliantly colored macaw taking flight from the canopy. Red, blue and yellow feathers blaze against the darkening light as the wings beat powerfully at the air. Raindrops begin to fall, striking the huge tropical leaves. Lightning illuminates the grey clouds in the distance. Slow-motion tracking of the macaw in flight.

High-speed cinematography, a cheetah at full sprint across the African savanna in pursuit of an antelope. The body is fully extended, all four limbs off the ground, spotted coat flashing in the sun. Grass and dust kick up behind the churning legs. The background blurs to emphasize speed, the horizon tilting slightly. Ultra slow-motion lateral tracking shot. Close-up.

Documentary photography style, Nara Park in Japan on an autumn morning, a group of sika deer grazing calmly on grass carpeted with red leaves. A fawn lifts its head toward the camera, ears up, nose twitching. Behind it the red pillars of an old temple and golden ginkgo trees fall out of focus. Fallen leaves drift down on the breeze. Soft backlight rims the deer. Medium shot, shallow depth of field.

Cinematic macro photography, a hummingbird hovering before a blooming red hibiscus, its wings beating so fast they blur to translucence. The slender bill probes into the flower's heart for nectar while the tiny body holds perfect balance in the air. Dew on the petals glitters like diamonds in the morning light. The background dissolves entirely into soft green. Ultra slow-motion close-up.

Nature documentary aerial shot, hundreds of puffins standing along the cliff edge above an Icelandic black sand beach. One puffin opens its colorful bill, spreads its wings into the sea wind and dives down along the cliff face. Grey waves shatter into white foam on the rocks below. Overcast diffuse light evenly fills the scene. The camera follows the puffin from the clifftop wide shot down to the water.

Cinematic night cinematography, the Arctic tundra under moonlight, an arctic fox stepping carefully across the snow. Its white coat nearly merges with the ground; only the black eyes and nose tip stand out. The aurora dances overhead, a green curtain reflected on the snow. The fox stops abruptly, ears up and listening, then leaps and plunges headfirst into the snow to hunt. Medium shot from the side.

Documentary-style underwater cinematography, a huge sea turtle swimming slowly over colorful coral in the shallows of a reef. Its front flippers sweep as gracefully as wings, a little algae clinging to the shell. Schools of tropical fish dart around it, and sunlight through the clear water casts swaying patterns of light. The camera tracks parallel to the turtle and pushes slowly in. Medium shot.

Cinematic high-speed photography, a bald eagle diving from altitude toward a lake to fish. The talons open at the instant they touch the water, throwing up a huge splash, and close on a silver trout. The wings beat hard and lift prey and bird into the air, water flicking off the feathers like shards of silver. Blurred blue mountains behind. Ultra slow-motion, low-angle shot.

Cinematic portrait cinematography, a Tokyo street on a rainy night, a young East Asian woman in a black trench coat holding a transparent umbrella and looking back toward the camera. Wet black hair clings to her cheek, her gaze steady and faintly sorrowful. Neon casts interlacing red and blue light across her face. Raindrops bounce off the umbrella, and headlights behind her melt into soft bokeh. Close half-body portrait.

Documentary film style, a Paris flower market before dawn, a white-haired old woman bending to arrange bundles of purple lavender. She wears a dark blue apron, her wrinkled fingers tying the bouquets deftly. Soft morning light falls through the iron canopy, and rows of flowers form a vivid backdrop around her. The camera pulls slowly from a close-up of her hands out to a medium shot.

Sports cinematography style, a young Black surfer riding a huge wave on a California beach at dusk. In a black wetsuit, knees bent for balance, spray churning and flying behind him. The golden setting sun backlights the crest of the wave into translucent amber. Low-angle underwater camera looking up. Slow-motion medium shot.

Cinematic humanist photography, a narrow alley in the old city of Marrakesh, an elderly Arab man in a white robe leading a donkey loaded with colorful fabrics through the lane. Weathered ochre mud walls throw long deep shadows on both sides, and a shaft of harsh sunlight cuts through an archway further on. The man's pace is slow and steady. Locked-off frontal camera as he walks from far away toward the lens.

Japanese cinematic style, the Philosopher's Path in Kyoto in full cherry blossom, a young Japanese woman in a pale pink kimono walking slowly along a path carpeted with petals. She holds a paper parasol, head slightly bowed, her geta tapping the flagstones. Cherry petals drift down on the breeze like pink snow. A brook babbles alongside the path. Lateral tracking shot. Soft backlight, medium shot.

War-film texture, a firefighter running forward with a hose over his shoulder through a ruined street thick with smoke and dust. He wears a black helmet, his face under the mask streaked with sweat and ash, reflective stripes flashing in the firelight. Behind him, collapsed buildings and rising black smoke, embers flying. Handheld tracking with slight shake for immediacy. Close tracking shot of the run.

Documentary aerial cinematography, thousands of people throwing colored powder at each other in an Indian Holi festival square. Red, yellow, green and purple powders form enormous colored clouds in the air as the crowd laughs and dances. The camera looks down from high above and descends slowly into the middle of the crowd. Every face and garment is caked in color. A scene full of joy and energy. Wide shot to medium shot.

Film noir style, inside a Chicago jazz bar late at night, a Black saxophonist playing with his eyes closed, utterly absorbed. A stage spotlight lights his sweat-shined face while smoke curls slowly through the beam. He wears a dark blue suit, fingers moving quickly over the keys of a golden saxophone. The audience is lost in darkness. Close-up, slightly low angle.

Cinematic sports cinematography, a player slides across the wet grass after a flying tackle on a rain-soaked football pitch. Mud and torn grass spray up; his expression is focused and resolute. The ball spins in the air and raindrops read like silver needles under the floodlights. The stands blur into bokeh behind. Ultra slow-motion, low-angle side view.

Humanist documentary style, an old Sherpa in the Nepalese Himalaya climbing a mountain path with an enormous wicker basket on his back. His skin is dark and weathered with deep lines, a wool cap on his head, his thick legs planting each step firmly on the rock. Behind him, magnificent snow peaks and fluttering prayer flags. Thin cloud rises out of the valley. Medium frontal shot, slightly low angle.

IMAX nature documentary style, a full view of Skógafoss in Iceland, a vast curtain of water pouring off a sixty-meter cliff. Spray throws a rainbow across the front of the falls. A flock of gulls wheels and threads through the mist. Emerald moss covers the cliff walls on both sides. The camera tilts slowly up from the base of the falls to a wide shot at the clifftop.

Cinematic time-lapse, sunset in the Sahara, vast dunes rendered in sharply divided curves of gold and deep brown by the raking light. Wind lifts fine sand off the dune crests and carries it away like golden smoke. A line of camels in silhouette moves slowly along the foot of the dune. The sky grades from gold-orange to violet-red. Ultra-wide low-angle extreme wide shot.

Nature documentary aerial, a Norwegian fjord in autumn, the camera diving from the summit down to the emerald water. Steep granite cliffs on both sides are covered in interlaced red and yellow foliage. A white cruise ship makes slow headway through the narrow channel, leaving a V-shaped white wake. Thin mist wraps the mountainsides. Fast aerial push-in and descent.

Cinematic storm cinematography, an enormous supercell thunderstorm rotating and churning over the American Great Plains. A funnel of spinning air reaches down from the ink-green cloud base. Lightning flickers constantly inside the cloud, lighting the whole mass from within. In the foreground an endless field of golden wheat thrashes in the gale. Locked-off extreme wide shot with time-lapse texture.

Documentary aerial shot, Mount Fuji in Japan at a winter dawn, the camera pushing in slowly from above a sea of cloud. Fuji's perfect cone rises out of the pink cloud layer, the snow at its summit glinting gold in the sunrise. The cloud sea spreads to the horizon like cotton. A thin wisp of volcanic gas drifts from the crater. Ultra-wide aerial pushing gradually into a medium shot.

Cinematic underwater cinematography, sunlight cutting through emerald tropical water to light the coral of the Great Barrier Reef. Vividly colored corals sway gently in the current while schools of clownfish dart among the anemones. Bubbles rise slowly from crevices in the coral. In the distance a manta ray spreads its huge wings and glides elegantly past. The camera pushes slowly forward through the coral.

Epic nature cinematography, the moment an Alaskan glacier calves, a huge block of blue ice breaking off the glacier front and crashing into the sea. The impact throws up waves tens of meters high and scatters shattered ice. Crevasses in the glacier surface grade from deep blue to white. Snow peaks stand silent in the distance under a grey-blue sky. Ultra slow-motion frontal medium shot. Overwhelming imagery.

Aerial documentary style, the Five Flower Lake at Jiuzhaigou, China, in autumn, shot straight down from high above. The water is an otherworldly weave of blue, green and yellow, the fallen logs on the bottom clearly visible. On the surrounding slopes, forests of red, yellow, orange and green blaze like an oil painting. A breeze crosses the surface, and the fine ripples shift the distribution of color. The aerial camera descends slowly while rotating.

Cinematic volcano cinematography, Kīlauea in Hawaii at night, molten lava surging and flowing out of a fissure. An orange-red river of lava winds slowly toward the sea, throwing up an enormous white steam cloud where it meets the water. Red light shows through the black crust congealed on the lava's surface. Stars glitter in the background. Telephoto medium shot of the flowing lava.

Nature-film style, the Grand Canyon after a spring storm, a rainbow arcing over the red rock canyon. Sunlight spears through gaps in the dark clouds in visible Tyndall beams. The Colorado River churns along the canyon floor in muddy red-brown. The rain has deepened and saturated the color of the rock walls. Helicopter aerial flying slowly along the canyon. Extreme wide shot.

Cinematic motorsport cinematography, a red Ferrari taking a bend at speed on a winding mountain road. The body leans, the tires smoke, the engine roars. Sunlight flares off the paintwork. Behind, a blurred Mediterranean coastline and the guardrail of the cliff road. Tracked from a helicopter alongside. Ultra slow-motion medium shot catching the moment of the turn.

Documentary aerial shot, at dusk a steam train crosses a stone viaduct in the Scottish Highlands. White steam jets from the locomotive and drifts apart in the golden sunset. The train's deep red carriages contrast against the emerald valley. Below the bridge lie a deep gorge and a winding stream. The camera tracks parallel from the side as the train crosses the viaduct. Aerial wide shot.

Naval-film style, a grey destroyer cutting through heavy seas in the stormy North Atlantic. Great waves slam the bow and burst into white spray a dozen meters high as the hull pitches and rolls. Dark cloud presses down on the water. The radar antenna on the bridge turns continuously. The camera shoots the ship breaking through the waves from a low side angle. Dynamic medium shot.

Science-fiction film style, a helicopter flying low across a fog-blanketed Manhattan skyline. The downwash from the rotor pushes the fog aside into swirling vortices. The lights of the skyscrapers become soft halos in the mist. The helicopter's side door is open, revealing red cabin light inside. Shot from a second aircraft. Night aerial cinematography, medium shot.

Documentary style, a wooden boat loaded with fresh flowers rowing slowly along the Mekong in Vietnam at dawn. The boat is piled with yellow marigolds and pink lotus, and a Vietnamese woman in a conical hat stands at the stern working the oar. Mist hangs over the river, reflecting the coconut palms on both banks. Ripples spread slowly from the hull. Soft morning light, frontal medium shot.

High-end food-commercial style, ultra slow-motion of the instant a fresh strawberry drops into milk. The red fruit throws up a milk-white crown of splash, droplets flying outward. The tiny seeds and beads of water on the strawberry's surface are perfectly sharp. A pure black background isolates the color of the food. High-speed macro close-up, frontal.

Japanese culinary cinematography, a sushi chef's hands forming nigiri on a cypress board with practiced ease. The fingertips shape the vinegared rice precisely and a slice of fresh salmon is laid over it. Up close, the translucent grain of the fish and the sheen of the rice are clearly visible. Behind, a blurred wooden counter and warm lighting. Close-up of the hands from above.

Food-commercial cinematic shot, an oven door swinging slowly open on a golden, crisp French croissant just out of the oven. Heat rises off its surface, the laminated layers distinct and glossy with butter. The camera pushes out from inside the oven, following the pastry. Warm backlight rims the croissant's outline. Macro close-up in slow motion.

Cinematic storm cinematography, lightning splits the night sky and strikes a lone oak standing in open country. The flash lights the boiling clouds and the twisted branches around it. Rain falls in torrents, the sheets of water turned to a silver curtain by the lightning. Leaves whip violently in the wind. High-speed capture of the instant the lightning forks. Locked-off frontal medium shot.

Nature documentary style, the aurora dancing across a starry sky inside the Arctic Circle. Green and violet curtains of light billow and fold through the heavens like silk. A frozen lake mirrors the aurora's colors perfectly. The black silhouette of a conifer forest stands still in the distance. A reindeer walks slowly across from the right of frame. Time-lapse accelerating the aurora's motion. Ultra-wide wide shot.

Industrial-film style, a ladle of glowing steel pouring into a mold on a steelworks floor. The searing orange metal flows thick as lava, sparks spraying into the air in a spectacular rain of fire. A worker in a protective visor operates the equipment further back. Red heat-light fills the shop. Slow-motion medium shot from the side as the steel pours.

Spaceflight documentary style, the instant of ignition and liftoff on a rocket launch pad. Enormous white clouds boil out from the base of the pad as orange flame pushes the rocket slowly clear of the tower and accelerates it upward. The service tower appears and disappears in the smoke. The ground shakes and ripples cross the puddles. The camera tilts up from the ground to track the ascent.

Sports-film slow motion, the moment a swimmer leaves the block and enters the pool. The body is a perfect streamline as it pierces the surface, throwing up a symmetrical splash. Underwater, bubbles sheath the whole body like silver armor. Blue pool light runs across the skin. A split frame shows the above- and below-water views at once. Ultra slow-motion close-up.

Sports documentary cinematic style, a woman marathon runner crossing the Golden Gate Bridge alone at dawn. She wears fluorescent green shoes, her ponytail swinging rhythmically with her stride. Morning fog wreathes the bridge towers, and the San Francisco skyline appears faintly through it in the distance. Her footfalls kick up a thin mist off the roadway. Low-angle tracking from the side. Medium shot.

Experimental-film style, macro photography of a drop of ink spreading slowly into clear water. On contact the deep blue ink builds a mushroom-cloud structure, filamentary tendrils reaching outward. Tiny disturbances in the water create continuously shifting fractal patterns. Backlighting renders the edges of the ink a translucent indigo. Ultra slow-motion frontal macro close-up.

High-speed photographic art, the instant a wine glass shatters against a white background. Shards fly outward radially while the red wine forms an elegant liquid sculpture in the air. Every fragment catches the ambient light and glitters like a diamond. Time seems frozen at the most beautiful instant of the break. Ultra slow-motion close-up from the side.

Period-film texture, Zhuque Avenue in Tang-dynasty Chang'an at dusk, a mounted escort galloping past along the broad street beside a carriage. High ward walls line both sides; taverns and teahouses hang silk lanterns. Hooves throw up yellow dust, and banners snap in the evening wind. The setting sun stains the city gate tower gold-red. Aerial tracking of the riders. Cinematic wide shot.

Epic war-film style, cavalry of two medieval armies charging and colliding in the fog. Armored knights swing longswords at the gallop, warhorses screaming, mud flying under their hooves. Banners sway and topple in the melee. Morning mist and dust mix across the battlefield. The camera weaves through the riders as it tracks. Handheld texture, medium shot.

Deep-sea expedition film style, a submersible's floodlight picking out a bloom of jellyfish in the black depths. The transparent bells glow with blue and violet bioluminescence, tentacles drifting through the current like a dancer's skirts. Further off, more luminous creatures blink in the dark. Particles in the water float like stars in the beam. The camera pushes slowly forward through the swarm.

Documentary underwater cinematography, a shipwreck overgrown with coral and marine life. A school of silver jacks forms a rotating vortex around the rusted hull. Sunlight from the surface lights the wreck's portholes and railings. Seaweed streams in the current like green ribbon. The camera moves slowly from the bow along the length of the hull. Medium shot.

Documentary film style, a Thai floating market at dawn, dozens of wooden boats loaded with tropical fruit and vegetables drifting along the canal. A Thai vendor in a straw hat stands in her boat handing a bunch of mangoes to tourists on the bank. The water reflects the wooden houses and palms on both sides. Hulls knock softly against each other. The camera looks down from a bridge and pans slowly. Wide shot.

Humanist cinematography, a Mexico City street on the night of the Day of the Dead, a young Latina with an intricately painted skull face and a crown of marigolds walking slowly down a candlelit corridor. Hundreds of candles flicker in rows on the ground and golden marigold petals carpet the path. Her black skirt sways with her steps. Warm candlelight plays over the face paint. Frontal medium tracking shot.

Science-fiction concept shot, autonomous flying cars threading along an elevated freeway of a future city on a rainy night. Raindrops run off the streamlined bodies, and blue thrusters glow softly underneath. Holographic advertisements flicker and warp in the curtain of rain. In the distance the tops of giant skyscrapers disappear into low cloud. The camera tracks through the traffic. Cyberpunk color palette.

Hard science-fiction style, a woman astronaut in a white suit floating in zero gravity before the observation window of a space station. She reaches out to touch the glass; beyond it the blue Earth turns slowly. Instrument panels glow green inside the module. Her hair floats loose in the weightlessness. Sunlight through the window creates harsh contrast between light and shadow. Close-up from the side.

Concert cinematography, a rock band playing full-tilt on a huge outdoor festival stage. The singer throws his arms wide toward tens of thousands of people as stage pyrotechnics throw golden sparks up behind him. Raised phone lights in the crowd form a sea of stars. Giant LED screens play psychedelic visuals. The camera pushes from behind the stage out toward the audience. Extreme wide shot.

Classical-music film style, a symphony orchestra performing in the Golden Hall in Vienna. The conductor's hands sweep passionately, the tails of his coat flying with the motion. The violinists' bows move as one. The crystal chandeliers in the gilded vault refract a warm glow. The camera rises slowly from behind the conductor to look down over the whole orchestra. Medium shot to wide shot.

Craftsman documentary style, an elderly potter in Kyoto throwing a pot at the wheel. His old, strong hands shape the spinning wet clay steadily, and the clay rises between his fingers into the graceful outline of a vase. The wheel keeps turning, flinging off excess slip. Natural window light rakes across the workbench from the side. Close-up of the hands from the side.

Culinary cinematic style, a teppanyaki chef searing beef on a scorching iron plate. Fat hisses as it hits the heat and flame leaps half a meter off the griddle. The chef's hands work the spatulas, tossing the ingredients into the air to turn them. Steam and aroma rise under warm overhead lights. Diners watch from the counter opposite. Frontal medium shot of the cooking.

Extreme-weather documentary style, a tornado forming and touching down on the plains of the American Midwest. A vast funnel cloud rotates down from the grey-black cloud base to the ground, lifting soil and debris into a brown spinning column. Hay from the surrounding fields is sucked into the air. Lightning flickers repeatedly inside the cloud. Distant telephoto lens, locked off. Extreme wide shot.

Disaster-film texture, an aerial shot of a tsunami wave approaching the Japanese coast. A grey wall of water more than ten meters high advances on the shore, white foam curling at its crest. Fishing boats in the harbor pitch violently as the surge reaches them. Spray bursts high over the breakwater. The buildings of the town beyond are clearly visible under the dark sky. Aerial wide shot pushing quickly into a medium shot.

Dance-film style, a ballerina spinning and leaping on the concrete floor of an abandoned factory. She dances in a white tutu among rusting steel beams, the skirt opening with each turn like a blooming flower. Dust swirls in the slanted shafts of sunlight from the windows. Her body casts moving shadows on the mottled walls. The camera orbits her in slow motion. Medium shot.

Flamenco cinematography, a woman in a red dress stamping fiercely in an old tavern in Seville. Her hands are raised, castanets cracking, her long black hair flying as she snaps her head. The red skirt opens like flame in the rapid turns. A guitarist plays furiously in the shadows. A spotlight from above creates dramatic chiaroscuro. Close half-body shot.

Tech-product commercial cinematography, a silver robotic arm assembling a microchip with precision in a cleanroom. The manipulator picks up minute components to millimeter tolerance and places them on the circuit board. LED indicators reflect cold blue off the metal surfaces. Behind it, rows of identical arms at the same work. The camera pushes from a wide view into a macro close-up of the assembly.

Data-center documentary style, countless blue indicator lights blinking in the dark like a starfield inside an enormous server hall. Airflow from the cooling system stirs the hem of a technician's white coat. He walks slowly down the aisle between towering racks, checking the equipment. Cold blue light seeps up through the floor. The camera pushes slowly forward from the end of the aisle. Symmetrical composition.

Pastoral cinematic style, harvest season in golden paddy fields, a red combine harvester advancing slowly through the vast crop. Cut ears of rice are drawn into the machine and golden grain sprays from the chute into the trailer. The setting sun throws long shadows across the field. Distant hills sit blue-green under drifting white cloud. The aerial camera descends slowly from high above to the side of the harvester.

Documentary photography style, the Yuanyang rice terraces of Yunnan at dawn, a Hani farmwoman leading a water buffalo along a paddy ridge. Tier upon tier of flooded terraces mirror the pink-violet light of the sunrise. The buffalo plods forward, muddy water splashing under its hooves. Thin mist rises out of the valley and threads between the terraces. Aerial and ground shots intercut. Extreme wide shot to medium shot.

Seafaring-film style, an old sailing ship pitching forward between huge waves in a storm. The white sails on all three masts are torn and bellied by the gale as sailors grip the lines on deck. Waves higher than the rail flood the deck and the hull heels hard over. Lightning splits the grey-black sky. The camera shoots the ship's rise and fall from the height of the wave crests. Dynamic medium shot from the side.

Documentary aerial, a red research icebreaker pushing slowly through the Antarctic ice. The bow shatters white floes that roll and pile up along both sides of the hull. All around lies an endless white ice field. A few penguins watch curiously from the ice in the distance. The sky is that particular polar grey-blue. Aerial tracking of the ship breaking ice. Wide shot.

Night cinematography, a corner tower of the Forbidden City under a full moon, mirrored in the moat. Moonlight on the golden glazed tiles takes on a cold blue sheen. A breeze wrinkles the water and the reflection breaks into glittering flakes of gold. Willow branches sway gently in the night air. Red lanterns on the distant wall glow warm yellow. Telephoto, locked off. A still, quiet medium shot.

Night documentary style, a street in Gangnam, Seoul, on a rainy night, pedestrians hurrying under umbrellas beneath an enormous LED screen. The advertisement on the screen becomes a flowing colored reflection on the wet ground. A couple share one umbrella as they run across the road. Red taxi tail lights drag long trails through the rain. Locked-off camera on the passing crowd. Medium shot.

Expedition-film style, a climber working his way up a Himalayan ridge line. In a red shell jacket he takes step after step up the steep, snow-covered arête. Wind lifts spindrift off the ridge and blows it away on both sides. A bottomless drop falls away beneath his feet. Distant snow peaks show their summits above a sea of cloud. Aerial tracking from the side. Vertiginous medium shot.

Nature-film style, an Alpine summer pasture, a herd of brown-and-white cows grazing placidly on a bright green slope. The bronze bells at their necks ring clearly with every movement. Behind them, snow-capped peaks and a wooden herder's hut. Wildflowers dot the grass and nod in the wind. The camera moves slowly from a wide view into a medium shot among the herd. Soft daylight.

Railway documentary cinematic style, a silver bullet train running at speed through the Japanese countryside in spring. Cherry trees enclose the track on both sides like a pink tunnel, and the train's slipstream lifts petals into the air. The streamlined nose reflects the sky. In the distance Mount Fuji appears and disappears between the blossoms. Low frontal angle as the train comes head-on.

Western-film style, a freight train crossing the desert of the American West. Dozens of rust-red cars snake like a long serpent across an arid canyon. The diesel locomotive throws black smoke. Red rock and cactus line the track. The setting sun washes the whole frame in warm orange. Aerial parallel tracking from the side. Ultra-wide extreme wide shot.

Warm family-film style, a little girl in a red coat running through piles of fallen leaves in Central Park in autumn. She spreads her arms, laughing and spinning, kicking up golden leaves that flutter around her like butterflies. Sunlight falls dappled through the yellowing canopy. A golden retriever bounds beside her, chasing the leaves. Slow-motion medium tracking shot.

Documentary family-film style, a father lifting his small son high and tossing him into the air at sunset by the sea. The boy laughs with his limbs spread wide in mid-air while the father holds out his arms to catch him. Golden backlight rims father and son in silhouette. Waves lap the shore behind them under a sky graded orange to violet. Slow-motion medium shot from the side. A warm image.

IMAX space documentary style, the International Space Station passing over the night side of Earth. The station's huge solar arrays catch the sunlight like golden wings spread wide. City lights on the surface below are arranged like constellations. A thin blue band of atmosphere traces the curve of the Earth. The station drifts slowly along; the Milky Way is clearly visible beyond. Telephoto tracking shot.

Science-fiction style, a first-person tracking shot of an astronaut walking on the lunar surface. Grey regolith puffs up under each boot and settles again slowly. In the distance the Earth hangs as a blue-white hemisphere in the black sky. The white suit throws harsh glare in the sunlight. Footprints leave crisp impressions in the dust. Low-angle close tracking shot.

High-fashion commercial cinematography, a tall Black supermodel in a flowing gold gown walking across desert dunes. The skirt billows and folds in the hot desert wind like liquid metal. Her stride is firm and powerful, bare feet leaving prints in the fine sand. The setting sun gilds her outline. The curves of the dunes run back to the horizon. Frontal medium shot.

Fashion cinematography, an Asian male model in a black leather jacket riding a vintage motorcycle through the streets of Los Angeles at night. Street lamps and neon slide across the chrome as flowing streaks of light. His scarf streams in the wind. A camera mounted on the side of the bike shoots his face and upper body from close range. City lights race past behind. Close tracking shot.

Festival documentary cinematic style, fireworks bursting over a city on Chinese New Year's night. Gold, red and green shells open one after another in the night sky like giant flowers. The river below mirrors the whole display. Rows of red lanterns glow under the eaves of old buildings on both banks. Crowds stop on the bridge to look up and cheer. The camera shoots past the crowd toward the sky. Medium shot to wide shot.

Documentary film style, the Rio de Janeiro carnival parade moving down the Sambadrome. Dancers in extravagant feathered costumes work their hips to the samba. Giant floats are dressed with mirrored panels and colored lights. Confetti and streamers drift down from above. Tens of thousands in the stands cheer and wave. The camera weaves between the dancers. Kinetic medium shot.

Craftsman-film style, an old embroiderer in Suzhou working at her frame on a piece of Su embroidery. In reading glasses, her slender fingers draw the silk thread through the silk ground with fine, precise stitches. The thread shimmers with rainbow luster in the daylight. On the cloth a crane takes shape, every feather distinct. The camera pushes from a wide view into a macro close-up of the needle passing through the silk.

Whisky distillery documentary style, a distiller in the Scottish Highlands pulling the bung from an oak cask to draw a sample. Amber whisky runs from the cask into a glass. Hundreds of casks are stacked neatly to the ceiling of the warehouse, the air thick with peat and oak. Weak window light picks out the floating dust. Close-up of the hands from the side during the sampling.

Extreme-sports film style, a wingsuit flyer leaping from a cliff edge and gliding through a Swiss valley. The suit inflates in the airflow like bat wings. He flies fast along the sheer rock face with dark green pine forest and a silver stream below. GoPro first-person views alternate with distant aerials. Adrenaline-charged high-speed imagery.

Surf cinematography, a surfer riding inside a ten-meter barrel on the North Shore of Hawaii. The emerald wall curls overhead into a perfect tube, sunlight glowing through the back of the wave in a green halo. White spray blasts from the mouth of the barrel. The surfer crouches low and reaches out to touch the wall. Underwater camera looking up. Slow-motion close-up.

Aviation-film style, a formation of fighter jets flying tight through blue sky and white cloud. Four silver aircraft trail white contrails in parallel lines across the sky. Sunlight flashes off the metal skin. The leader banks slightly into a turn and the others adjust in perfect synchrony. Shot from the cockpit perspective of a wingman. Close aerial cinematography.

Civil-aviation documentary style, a cockpit view of a white airliner flying through storm cloud. Beyond the windscreen, lightning lights the boiling cumulonimbus and raindrops streak across the glass at speed. Green indicator lights blink on the instrument panel. The captain's hands are steady on the yoke, his eyes forward. The airframe shudders slightly in the turbulence. Close interior cockpit shot.

Road-movie style, a battered blue pickup speeding down Route 66 in a cloud of dust. Endless desert scrub and red mesas on both sides. The window is down and the driver's arm hangs out into the hot wind. In the mirror the straight road vanishes into heat shimmer on the horizon. Low-angle tracking from the side. Golden-hour medium shot.

Expedition documentary style, an archaeologist riding a camel through the narrow Siq in the ancient city of Petra, Jordan. Red sandstone walls tower on both sides, their strata curving like flowing water. The camel's pace is slow and sure, gravel crunching softly underfoot. Ahead, a corner of the Treasury appears at the end of the gorge. Locked-off frontal shot as the rider approaches from far away.

Cinematic stabilized tracking shot, an old man pushing a breakfast cart slowly past grey brick walls in a Beijing hutong before dawn. White steam rises from the bamboo steamers and dissipates in the cold air. Red door couplets and stone lions stand silent in the morning light. Further off, a tabby cat jumps onto the roof tiles and walks along the ridge. The camera follows slowly from behind the old man and pushes in. Documentary-style medium shot.

Cinematic aerial long take, Hongyadong in Chongqing at night in heavy rain, the stacked stilt houses lit up like a golden honeycomb hung on the cliff face. Rain pours off the eaves in sheets of water. Dense ripples pock the Jialing River, and pleasure-boat lights drag blurred reflections across it. The camera rises slowly from the water and tilts up over the whole complex. Wide shot.

Documentary film style, a red double-decker bus crossing Westminster Bridge on a foggy London morning. Only the vague outline of Big Ben shows through the thick fog; pedestrians pull their coats tight and hurry across the span. Grey vapor rises off the Thames. A flock of pigeons startles up from the balustrade. Locked-off camera at the head of the bridge as the bus approaches from far away.

Cyberpunk color palette, the Myeongdong shopping street in Seoul late at night, giant holographic advertisements throwing moving light across the building facades. A young man in fluorescent green sneakers rides a skateboard through the crowd over the slick pavement. Standing water reflects the neon in warped colors. Low-angle camera from ground level following the board.

Architectural cinematic style, the interior of the Sagrada Família in Barcelona at midday, stained glass splitting the sunlight into rainbow shafts that fall across the white columns. The patches of color slide slowly over the stone as the sun moves. A group of tourists walks slowly with heads tilted back, shadows stretching on the floor. Tree-like columns branch toward the ceiling. The camera tilts up from the floor and rises slowly while rotating.

Documentary aerial cinematography, the ruins of Machu Picchu emerging from a sea of cloud at dawn. The first light strikes the stone complex on the summit and works its way down the terraces. A few llamas graze quietly on the grass and lift their heads to look. Range after range of the Andes fades in and out of the morning mist beyond. The aerial camera breaks through the cloud layer and pushes toward the ruins.

Film noir style, a subway train thundering past on the elevated railway in Chicago late at night. Sparks off the rails light the wet asphalt below. A man with an umbrella waits under a street lamp, the ember of his cigarette brightening and fading. Light from the train windows draws fast-moving bars across the ground. Locked-off camera from across the street. High-contrast medium shot.

Cinematic golden-hour aerial, tourists and street performers thronging the Charles Bridge in Prague at sunset. The thirty black statues of saints cast long shadows in the golden light. The Vltava flows slowly beneath the bridge, reflecting the sky. A violinist plays at the parapet, his bow sweeping up and down. The aerial camera descends slowly toward the bridge deck.

Documentary film style, a Mumbai street during the monsoon, hundreds of people struggling through knee-deep water outside a railway station in the downpour. Colorful saris are soaked through and cling to the body; a mother lifts her child over her head as she wades. Yellow taxis crawl through the flood throwing up spray. Under the dull light everything is blurred by rain. Locked-off frontal shot of the crowd.

Epic aerial cinematography, the plain of Bagan in Myanmar in golden morning light, thousands of pagoda spires piercing the mist. A hot-air balloon rises slowly and drifts over the spires, casting a round shadow. In the distance the Irrawaddy glints through the haze like a silver ribbon. An ox cart moves slowly along a red dirt road, raising thin dust. The aerial camera looks down from the balloon's vantage and rotates slowly over the panorama.

Urban night cinematography, the Angels Flight funicular climbing its steep track in downtown Los Angeles after rain. The orange car reflects the street lamps off the wet rails. Palm trees sway gently in the night air on either side. Skyscrapers blaze with light further off. A young couple smile at each other through the car window. Low-angle shot from the bottom of the track as the car ascends.

Cinematic time-lapse aerial, the Supertrees at Gardens by the Bay in Singapore from day into night. Their lights come up as the sun sets, turning them from silver metal into glowing violet-blue structures. Visitors walk the skyway like ants. Marina Bay Sands lights up in the dusk beyond. Clouds race across the sky. Ultra-wide time-lapse panorama.

Old-city cinematic style, worshippers praying at the Western Wall in Jerusalem at dusk, heads bowed, bodies rocking gently back and forth. The low sun turns the great blocks of stone honey-gold; the crevices are stuffed with paper notes. A group of Orthodox Jews in black walks briskly across the plaza. Pigeons land and take off along the top of the wall. The camera pans slowly across the scene from a corner of the plaza. Humanist documentary medium shot.

Industrial-film style, giant gantry cranes loading containers at the port of Rotterdam at night. Colored containers weighing dozens of tons are lifted, swung slowly over a freighter and set down. Floodlights illuminate the busy quay. A terminal tractor threads between the stacks with its yellow beacon flashing. The camera looks down on the whole operation from high on the crane. Night wide shot.

Documentary aerial cinematic style, a pink 1957 Chevrolet convertible speeding along the Malecón in Havana at dawn. Waves break over the seawall and wash across the road. Colorful colonial buildings flick past in the background. The driver, in sunglasses, steers one-handed and smiles. Low-altitude aerial tracking alongside the car. Golden morning light, medium shot.

Wildlife documentary style, a brown bear standing in the rapids of an Alaskan river with its mouth open, waiting. A silver salmon leaps from the water straight into its jaws. Spray soaks the bear's thick fur. Several more salmon jump upstream through the white water around it. Dark green conifer forest lines both banks. Slow-motion medium shot from the side catching the moment of the bite.

Nature documentary macro, a chameleon moving slowly along a branch in the tropical rainforest. Its eyes swivel independently to scan around it while its skin shades from green to brown to match the surroundings. The long tongue snaps out at lightning speed, takes a flying insect and retracts. The clawed feet grip the branch as it steps steadily forward. The background dissolves into tropical green. Ultra slow-motion close-up.

Aerial nature documentary, tens of thousands of wildebeest crossing the Mara River during the East African migration. The brown flood of animals pours into the muddy water and swims desperately for the far bank. Heads pack the surface like a heaving wave. Enormous clouds of dust rise on the shore. A crocodile lying in wait suddenly attacks. The aerial camera descends from high above and closes in on the water.

Cinematic night cinematography, a lone grey wolf howling at the sky on moonlit snow. Its grey-white coat glitters silver in the moonlight. Breath jets from the open mouth and turns to white vapor in the cold. Behind it stretch endless snowfields and sparse birch. A full moon hangs huge and round above the treetops. Low-angle shot from the side. Medium shot with a silhouette effect.

Underwater documentary style, a school of hammerhead sharks swimming in formation through the deep blue off the Galápagos. Dozens of sharks hold a neat diamond formation, their hammer-shaped heads swinging side to side through the current. Sunlight from the surface throws rippling patterns across their grey skin. The camera rises slowly from beneath the school, looking up. Grand medium shot.

Nature documentary slow motion, a kingfisher diving from a branch into a stream to fish. Blue and orange feathers flash like gemstones, and clear droplets burst up at the moment of entry. It flies out with a small fish in its bill and shakes off the water, the droplets scattering like diamond dust in the sun. The whole action takes under two seconds. Ultra slow-motion macro from the side.

BBC documentary texture, a huddle of emperor penguins pressed tightly together for warmth in an Antarctic blizzard. The birds on the outside bow their heads and hunch their backs against the cutting wind while fluffy grey chicks show above the heads of those inside. The storm forms a white wall behind them. The whole huddle shuffles slowly as they rotate between the outside and the middle. Locked-off frontal shot. Medium shot.

Nature-photography cinematic style, a family of elephants drinking and playing at an African waterhole at dusk. A calf sucks up water in its trunk and sprays its companions. A cow curls mud up in her trunk and plasters it on her back to cool down. The setting sun turns the water gold-red and the elephants' reflections waver on it. A flock of flamingos stands on the shallows in the distance. The aerial camera descends slowly to water level.

Rainforest documentary, an orangutan swinging through the canopy of the Bornean rainforest on vines. Its long red arms grip the vine powerfully and carry it across to the next tree. Shaken leaves flutter down. An infant clings tightly to its mother's waist through the swing. Sunlight through gaps in the canopy makes alternating patches of light and shade. Low camera looking up and following the movement.

Macro documentary cinematic style, a spider repairing a hole in a dew-covered web at dawn. The fine silk sags slightly under the weight of the droplets like a string of pearls. The spider's eight legs move nimbly along the threads while the spinnerets pay out new silk. Morning light from behind makes the whole web glow like a diamond lattice. Locked-off macro close-up. Soft backlight.

Nature-film night cinematography, an aye-aye in the Madagascar rainforest tapping a tree trunk with its long thin middle finger to find grubs. Its huge eyes flash orange in the night-vision light and its bushy tail stands high. The tapping echoes through the silent forest. Having found a tunnel, it jabs the finger in, hooks out a larva and puts it in its mouth. Infrared camera, close-up from the side.

Marine documentary cinematic style, a giant octopus extending all eight arms through the crevices between rocks as it explores forward. The suckers grip and release along the rock in sequence, like walking. Skin color and texture change instantly with the surroundings, from red-brown to rock grey. A small fish swims past and the octopus shoots out an arm and wraps it up in a flash. Underwater close tracking shot.

High-speed documentary photography, a dragonfly hovering over a pond and dipping to lay eggs. The transparent wings beat thirty times a second, every stroke clearly resolved in slow motion. The tip of the abdomen touches the water and raises the tiniest ripple. Sunlight through the thin wings shows iridescent interference fringes. Blurred green lotus pads behind. Ultra slow-motion macro from the side.

African documentary cinematic style, a leopard draped lazily over the thick horizontal branch of an acacia, limbs hanging down. Its spotted coat blends into the dappled light on the bark. Suddenly its ears prick and its head lifts, amber eyes locking on distant prey, muscles tightening to drop. The tip of the tail twitches. The camera pushes from a wide view in to a close-up of the leopard's face.

Documentary underwater slow motion, a pod of dolphins swimming in unison beneath a sunset-lit sea surface. Their silver bodies trace elegant arcs through the water, and now and then one breaks the surface, spins in the air and drops back in white spray. Golden sunset light penetrates the water and lights the pod. Bubbles rise from the blowholes. Underwater parallel tracking from the side.

Wuxia-film style, a white-haired Taoist practising tai chi before a monastery on Mount Wudang in the morning mist. In grey robes, his movements flow like water, slow and strong. His long beard lifts as he turns. Thin mist curls over the flagstones at his feet. Distant peaks appear and vanish in a sea of cloud. The camera orbits slowly from the side. Soft-light full-body medium shot.

Documentary film style, an old fishmonger butchering an enormous bluefin tuna at Tsukiji market at three in the morning. The long blade cuts precisely along the grain of the fish, the deep red flesh glossy with fat under the cold white light. Shaved ice and scales fly. Buyers stand around talking. Frontal shot at bench height of the cutting. Medium close-up.

Western-film texture, an old cowboy on a chestnut horse driving cattle across a dusty Texas plain. In a felt hat, he cracks his whip in the air while the herd runs ahead raising a brown curtain of dust. Backlight from the setting sun reduces everything to dark gold silhouette. A windmill turns slowly on the horizon. Aerial tracking from the side. Extreme wide shot.

Humanist documentary style, an Omo woman on the Ethiopian highlands carrying a clay pot on her head along a red dirt path. Layer upon layer of colored bead necklaces hang at her neck, and the lip plate catches the sun. She walks barefoot and steady through golden grass, the pot perfectly still on her head. Smoke rises from a thatched village beyond. Frontal medium shot pushing in slowly.

Boxing-film style, two fighters trading blows under the ring lights. One lands a right hook on the other's cheek, and sweat and mist burst outward from the point of impact. The instant the glove deforms is caught cleanly in slow motion. The ropes shudder with the impact. The crowd roars from the darkness. Ultra slow-motion, low-angle frontal close-up of the punch.

Japanese cinematic style, an elderly man in an indigo kimono walking alone with a bamboo umbrella through the Arashiyama bamboo grove in Kyoto. Towering bamboo rises straight on both sides like a green vault. The leaves rustle in the breeze and small patches of light move along the path. A temple bell sounds in the distance. Locked-off frontal camera as the figure approaches slowly from far away. Symmetrical composition.

Music-film style, a brass band marching and playing in the sun in the French Quarter of New Orleans. The trombonist works the slide through a soaring line while the trumpeter blows with his head thrown back. They wear white shirts and black suspenders and step in time. Onlookers clap and sway to the beat. Sunlight flashes gold off the brass. Medium tracking shot.

War-film style, a young soldier pressed against the wall of a muddy trench, head down, breathing hard. His helmet is caked in mud, his face blackened by smoke so that only the whites of his eyes stand out. A shell bursts further off, throwing up earth, and the shockwave shakes dirt loose from the trench wall. He grips his rifle and sets his jaw, ready to go over. Grim, oppressive palette. Frontal close-up, slightly high angle.

Documentary film style, an old Uyghur coppersmith squatting in a doorway in the old town of Kashgar, hammering a copper pot. The hammer strikes the metal rhythmically with a clear ringing. Fine geometric patterns emerge gradually across the surface. The old man's beard is streaked with white, the veins standing out on his hands. Sunlight from above the narrow lane lights the flying copper dust. Close-up of the hands from above.

Cinematic portrait in slow motion, a Black dancer performing contemporary dance in an empty industrial warehouse. In a loose white shirt she spins and leaps barefoot on the concrete. Flour falls from the ceiling through the spotlight beam like snow. Every sweep of the arm and turn of the body throws up powder in trails of motion. Slow motion captured from several angles. Medium shot, artful light.

Documentary-photographic cinematic style, the dawn puja on the Ganges at Varanasi. A Brahmin priest swings a brass lamp in circles on the ghat steps. The flame leaves orange traces in the morning mist. Hundreds of devotees immerse themselves and pray in the river, marigold garlands floating on the water. Blue smoke curls upward. The camera pans slowly from a boat on the river. Wide shot.

Science-fiction style, a woman scientist in a laboratory examining a culture dish through a microscope. She lifts her goggles, revealing an intent gaze, and writes data quickly in her notebook. Behind her, instruments glow with blue-green fluid and tangled tubing. The sterile lamp casts cold white light. She pipettes reagent into the dish with precision. Close-up from the side.

Cinematic sports cinematography, a figure skater landing a quadruple jump. In a blue dress studded with rhinestones she spins four times at speed in the air and lands cleanly. The blade bites the ice and throws up a fine spray. The skirt opens in the spin like a flower. A follow spot lights her whole body. Ultra slow-motion, low angle from ice level.

Humanist documentary style, a worker standing barefoot in one of the great stone pits of a tannery in the old city of Fez, treading hides. The round pits are laid out in neat rows, each full of a different color of natural dye. The worker's skin is stained red-brown. Steam rises from the hot vats. The camera looks down on the whole works from the top of the surrounding wall. High-angle wide shot.

Cinematic portrait in rain, a young East Asian man in a white shirt standing in an empty parking lot in a downpour, face tilted up, eyes closed. The rain soaks the shirt against his body, his hair plastered to his forehead. In slow motion the drops run off his cheeks like clear beads. Headlights blur and flicker in the distance. The camera orbits slowly. Half-body close-up in slow motion.

Documentary film style, a group of pilgrims circumambulating Mount Kailash on the Tibetan plateau. In heavy robes, they advance by full-body prostration, one step and one bow at a time. The dirt on their foreheads and the devotion in their faces are deeply moving. Prayer flags snap in the strong wind. The snow mountain stands sacred against a deep blue sky. Low-angle tracking from the side. Medium shot.

Food documentary style, a heavyset Italian man in the old city of Naples tossing pizza dough in front of a brick oven. The dough spins in the air, growing wider and thinner with each throw. Open flame inside the oven lights his flour-covered apron and smiling face. He catches the base, spreads tomato and mozzarella and slides it into the oven. Frontal medium shot of the whole sequence.

Cinematic ballet photography, two dancers rehearsing a pas de deux lift in an empty studio. He raises her above his head and she extends her limbs in the air like a swan in flight. The great mirrored wall reflects both figures. Natural window light lays rectangles of brightness across the wooden floor. Dust drifts slowly through the beams. The camera pushes slowly from a wide view to a medium shot.

Street documentary cinematic style, an elderly Black saxophonist playing with his eyes closed in a New York subway car. Some passengers look down at their phones, others watch and listen. The train runs through the tunnel, lights flashing past in the darkness outside. The old man's face is deeply lined, his white hair unkempt. The saxophone glows warm gold under the car lights. Close portrait.

Sports-film slow motion, the instant a sprinter explodes out of the blocks. Explosive muscular power transfers through the limbs as the fingers leave the track, flicking up rubber crumb. The facial muscles distort with maximal effort. The spikes strike the track and kick up small particles. The background dissolves completely, leaving only the lane lines. Ultra slow-motion close-up from the side.

Nature-film aerial, Mount Yoshino in Japan in spring, the whole mountain in cherry blossom like a sea of pink cloud. A breeze sends petals whirling like snowflakes to settle slowly on the mountain paths. The vermilion roof of an old temple appears and disappears in the blossom. A stream runs along the valley floor, its surface covered in petals. The aerial camera glides slowly from the summit down to the valley. Wide shot.

Cinematic storm cinematography, huge waves striking the Cliffs of Moher in Ireland. Ten-meter columns of white water hurl themselves over the black clifftop and shatter into flying spray. Swells advance across the grey-green Atlantic in ranks like an army. Grass at the cliff edge thrashes almost flat in the gale. A few gulls struggle to hold position in the wind. Locked-off camera from the side. Medium shot.

Nature documentary time-lapse, a giant corpse flower in equatorial African rainforest opening from bud to full bloom. The deep red petals unfold slowly to reveal the yellow central spadix. Heat released by the flower forms faint vapor in the cool air. Insects drawn by the smell arrive continuously and gather on the petals. Frontal time-lapse macro of the opening.

Cinematic aerial, the Lofoten Islands in Norway during the polar night, violet and green aurora dancing violently in the sky above the fjord. Red wooden cottages in the fishing village glow warm yellow in the windows, mirrored in the still water. The outlines of snow peaks are clearly visible in the aurora's light. A fishing boat returns slowly to harbor, its lights trailing across the water. Time-lapse aerial wide shot.

Nature-film style, sunlight piercing the hundred-meter canopy of Redwood National Park in California. Golden shafts drive down through gaps in the crowns to the forest floor, lighting the spores and pollen adrift in the air. A deer steps out from behind a huge root into a shaft of light and is bathed in gold. Ferns carpet the ground in green. The camera tilts slowly up to the canopy.

Storm-chasing film style, an enormous rainbow arcing over a Nebraska wheat field after a storm. Dark cloud retreats out of frame to the right, revealing deep blue sky. Golden wheat rolls in the post-rain wind like an ocean. A red pickup sits on a muddy farm track. The last drops of rain glitter like diamonds in the sun. Locked-off extreme wide shot.

Cinematic volcanic time-lapse, a fissure eruption in Iceland at night. A curtain of orange-red lava erupts along hundreds of meters of ground crack. Lava fountains reach tens of meters, and clots of molten rock trace orange arcs through the air as they fall. Rivers of lava wind over the black lava field, glowing incandescent red. Steam rolls up into the night sky. Locked-off wide shot.

Nature documentary aerial, the meeting of the Amazon and the Rio Negro, where two colors of water run side by side for kilometers without mixing. The yellow-brown and the black form a sharp boundary. A pink river dolphin breaks the surface at the line. Rainforest walls of green run to the horizon on both banks. The aerial camera flies slowly along the boundary. Extreme wide shot.

Cinematic blizzard cinematography, a Hokkaido train crossing a white world of driving snow. Drifts on both sides of the track rise above the windows, forming a white tunnel. The headlights throw two cones of light into the snowy haze. Through the storm only the red tail lights can be made out, receding. Locked-off camera between the rails as the train pulls away. Minimal composition.

Nature-film aerial, a full view of Emerald Lake in the Canadian Rockies in autumn. The glacier-fed lake is an improbable jade green. On the slopes around it, golden larch and dark green spruce interweave like an oil painting. A bald eagle skims the lake, wingtips nearly touching the water. A breeze raises fine ripples on the surface. The aerial camera descends slowly and pushes in.

Cinematic tidal cinematography, the tide racing in around Mont-Saint-Michel under moonlight. The sea visibly floods across the flat sand and surrounds the base of the mount. Moonlight lays a silver road across the water to the horizon. The light on the abbey spire blinks in the darkness like a beacon. A flock of sheep on the sand runs for high ground ahead of the water. Time-lapse medium shot.

Nature documentary style, the moment an Icelandic geyser erupts. A column of boiling water bursts from the ground twenty meters into the air. The steam condenses instantly in the cold air into a huge white cloud. Droplets scatter through the air like rain. Sulfur crystals around the vent show yellow and white. Tourists at a safe distance step back in astonishment. Slow-motion frontal low angle.

Cinematic wilderness cinematography, the ruins of a lone castle in the Scottish Highlands during a storm. Lightning lights the broken grey walls and the collapsed tower. Rain pours off the ruined masonry in small waterfalls. Wild grass whips in the gale. A crow flies out of a broken window and vanishes into the rain. Locked-off frontal medium shot. Gothic dark palette.

Nature-film time-lapse style, the Milky Way turning slowly over the Sahara. The foreground is a black rocky desert, white quartz stones scattered across the ground glowing faintly in the starlight. A meteor crosses the galactic center and leaves a brief trace. Distant dune outlines read deep blue in the starlight. Locked-off ultra-wide time-lapse panorama.

Cinematic flood documentary, the Hukou Falls of the Yellow River after the spring thaw. Muddy yellow water drops with thunderous force from a riverbed dozens of meters wide into a deep gorge. Spray rises tens of meters and forms a huge rainbow in the sun. The rock walls shudder under the impact. Tourists behind the railing are soaked by the mist. Low-angle shot from directly in front of the falls. Overwhelming wide shot.

Motorsport film style, an F1 car taking a corner at speed on a wet track. The tires throw up two tall rooster tails of spray and the brake discs glow red in the rain. The low body skims the apex kerb as if flying. Spray forms vortices above the aerodynamic surfaces. Low-angle tracking from the outside of the corner. Ultra slow-motion medium shot.

Military-film style, three attack helicopters in formation flying low over a Southeast Asian jungle canopy at dawn. The rotor downwash bends the trees and blows leaves and water droplets in all directions. Thin mist swirls around the airframes. The cabin doors are open, showing the silhouettes of soldiers inside. Shot from the jungle floor looking up as they pass. Low-angle dynamic medium shot.

Seafaring documentary style, a traditional Polynesian double-hulled canoe running before the wind across the blue South Pacific. The woven sail bellies in the trade wind and the outrigger rides through the spray. Two sailors trim the lines to hold course. Sunlight drives through the water to a translucent jade green. The outline of a volcanic island shimmers in the heat haze in the distance. Aerial tracking from the side.

Cinematic night chase, a black Porsche drifting through a bend on the Tokyo Shuto Expressway. The tires smoke and lay black arcs on the asphalt. The city's night lights streak past the windows as colored bars. Blue flame spits from the exhaust. A camera mounted on a chase car shoots the whole drift from behind at a low angle. Close shot.

Railway documentary cinematic style, a green train crossing the vast rapeseed fields of Luoping in Yunnan. The bright yellow sea of flowers runs away on both sides to the foot of distant hills. The train's whistle echoes across the fields. Passengers lean out of the windows to take photographs. A breeze rolls the blossom like a golden ocean. The aerial camera rises slowly from directly above the train. Spectacular wide shot.

Space-film style, a space station's robotic arm unfolding slowly to grapple a floating satellite module. The joints extend one by one like enormous metal fingers. The satellite's solar panels flash gold in the sunlight. The curve of the Earth turns slowly at the bottom of the frame, blue ocean and white cloud clearly visible. An EVA astronaut floats further off, monitoring the operation. Medium shot.

Polar expedition documentary, an orange tracked polar vehicle grinding over pressure ridges on the Antarctic ice sheet. Fine ice crystals thrown up behind it glitter like diamond dust in the sun. Endless white ice runs to the horizon. Meteorological instruments spin on the roof in the wind. The sky is that distinctive polar ice-blue. Aerial shot from high above following the vehicle. Extreme wide shot.

Cinematic yacht-racing photography, a racing sailboat heeled to the limit on the crests in heavy wind. The crew hang fully outboard, using their weight to balance the boat as water sheets off the hull and across the deck. The carbon mast bows like a drawn bow under the load. The huge colored spinnaker booms as it fills. Water-level camera looking up. Dynamic medium shot.

Engineering documentary style, a giant tunnel boring machine turning against the rock face. Dozens of alloy cutters on the ten-meter cutterhead grind the rock, throwing sparks. Rubble and slurry pour continuously through the gaps in the head onto the conveyor. Rows of LEDs light the damp concrete lining of the tunnel. An engineer monitors the instrument panel alongside. Frontal medium shot.

Cinematic fire-service scene, a red fire engine racing down a street thick with smoke. The aerial ladder rises and extends as it moves. Firefighters jump down from the side, pull out hose and run toward the burning building. A jet from the high-pressure nozzle hits the flames and throws up an enormous cloud of steam. Firelight reddens the whole street. Locked-off camera from the building opposite. Dynamic medium shot of the whole scene.

Macro cinematic style, ultra slow motion of a raindrop falling from the tip of a leaf. At the instant it separates, the drop stretches into a teardrop, then strikes the puddle below and raises perfect concentric ripples with a rebound column at the center. Dew on the surrounding grass blades reflects tiny inverted worlds. The background dissolves entirely into emerald green. Ultra-high-speed frontal macro.

Cinematic glassmaking cinematography, an old craftsman in a Murano workshop drawing a glowing orange gather of molten glass from the furnace. He turns the blowpipe constantly and blows, and the glass swells into a transparent sphere. An assistant shapes it with tongs, drawing out an elegant neck. Furnace light reddens the craftsman's sweating face. Close-up of the blowing from the side.

Archaeological documentary cinematic style, an archaeologist in the Valley of the Kings brushing sand gently from a wall painting. Under the torch beam, three-thousand-year-old colors emerge gradually. The gold and blue pigments are still vivid. Dust in the tomb's air drifts slowly through the beam. The archaeologist holds her breath, working with great care. Close-up of the hands and the painting.

Nature-film style, thousands of glowworms glowing blue-green like a starfield across the dark vault of a New Zealand cave. A small wooden boat drifts silently on the underground river. The boatman pulls the craft along by rope without making a sound. The water mirrors the living constellation overhead perfectly. The only light in the frame is the glowworms' blue. Frontal medium shot.

Cinematic macro slow motion, dandelion seeds detaching from the head in a breeze. Each seed's white pappus rises slowly on the air like a miniature parachute. Backlight gives the filaments a golden halo. Against a blue sky the seeds drift apart on the wind and recede. Locked-off macro close-up. Dreamlike soft-focus texture.

Spy-thriller style, a man in a dark trench coat waiting beneath the snow-covered Prater Ferris wheel on a Viennese winter night. His breath is clearly visible under the street lamp and the red point of his cigarette brightens and fades. The wheel turns slowly, its lit cabins like a slowly revolving ring of light in the snowy night. A tram bell sounds in the distance. Locked-off frontal medium shot.

High-end jewelry commercial style, a diamond necklace turning slowly on a rotating display. Dozens of stones throw rainbow fire under the spotlight. The light off each facet flashes and jumps as the angle changes. A black velvet background isolates the brilliance. The macro lens pushes slowly in to a close-up of a single stone. Extreme detail.

Disaster-film style, a concrete building tilting and collapsing slowly into its own dust during an earthquake. Blocks of concrete and reinforcing bar collide as they fall. An enormous grey dust cloud boils out of the collapse and swallows the street. Crowds scream and run in the distance. The ground shakes violently and the camera shakes with it. Multi-angle slow motion of the whole collapse.

Cinematic aquarium cinematography, a blue jellyfish pulsing slowly upward in the darkness of a huge cylindrical tank. Every contraction of the translucent bell releases pale blue bioluminescence. The long tentacles trail through the water like dancing ribbons. The tank lighting creates a deep-sea indigo mood. A little girl presses close to the glass and looks up in wonder. Close-up from the side.

Classical-music film style, a woman cellist playing alone in an empty European stone church. The bow draws a deep, full line from the strings that resonates between the walls. Afternoon light through the stained glass lays blocks of color on the floor. Her eyes are closed, lost in the music, her body swaying slightly with the phrase. The camera descends slowly from the vault to a medium shot of the player.

Cinematic time-lapse from above, a full day over a city from sunrise to late night. Morning mist recedes to reveal the building outlines; by day, traffic and crowds pour through the streets like blood. The sun sets and the city's lights come up in sequence. Late at night only scattered headlights and blinking signals remain. Clouds race across the sky, dragging their shadows. Ultra-wide locked-off aerial time-lapse.

Documentary film style, dozens of colored hot-air balloons rising together at dawn in Cappadocia, Turkey. Red, yellow, blue and green envelopes lift slowly above the strange mushroom-rock landscape. The burners roar and throw orange flame. Passengers in the baskets look down excitedly. Morning light turns the whole rock valley gold. The aerial camera flies between the balloons. Wide shot.

Medical documentary cinematic style, a surgeon working intently under the operating lamp on a delicate procedure. Wearing loupes and a headlamp, she handles the instruments carefully. Blood on the gloves is clearly visible under the strong light. The monitor beeps rhythmically in the background. A nurse passes instruments in practiced coordination. Close-up of the hands at work.

Cinematic fireworks photography, huge chrysanthemum shells opening over the river at a Japanese hanabi festival. Golden sparks spread from the center like petals and then fall slowly like weeping willow. The river mirrors the whole display symmetrically. Spectators in yukata on both banks look up in amazement. The camera shoots past the crowd toward the sky. Medium shot to wide shot.

Diving documentary style, a descent into a cenote on Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula. The diver drops through the round mouth into crystal-clear fresh water underground. The shaft of light from the opening lights the blue water like a stage spot. Stalactites hang from the submerged vault like a forest of stone. The diver's bubbles rise along the beam and vanish at the surface. Shot from below, looking up.

Cinematic industrial cinematography, a master potter in Jingdezhen throwing a thin-walled bowl at speed on the wheel. The spinning clay thins and rises between his fingers as if by magic. Slip flies off under the centrifugal force. The wall becomes thin enough to be nearly translucent. When it is done he cuts the base free with a wire and lifts the bowl away gently. Natural light rakes in from a side window. Close-up of the hands.

Expedition-film style, a caver's headlamp lighting an enormous underground crystal chamber. Transparent selenite crystals grow across each other from floor and ceiling like giant swords. The caver climbs over a crystal column more than a meter thick. The headlamp refracts into thousands of points of light across the countless faces. Dripping water echoes from deep in the cave. Low-angle medium shot. Fantastical imagery.

Documentary aerial cinematography, the Atlantic Road in Norway, its winding bridges linking islands through heavy seas. A red car drives slowly over the curving, undulating deck. Waves smash into the piers and throw sheets of white water over the roadway. Grey sky and dark green sea create a vast, desolate feeling. Aerial shot from high above following the car. Extreme wide shot.

Cinematic time-lapse, the full growth of a sunflower from seed to bloom. The shoot breaks the soil and the stem climbs day by day. The leaves open and turn to follow the sun. The bud opens gradually from a green ball to reveal golden petals. Bees work the open disc for nectar. Behind, the sky and clouds accelerate from spring into summer. Time-lapse, frontal, macro to medium shot.

Deep-sea documentary style, a hydrothermal vent venting scalding black smoke. Around it, tube worms extend red plumes that sway in the current. White blind shrimp crowd densely at the edge of the hot zone. Minerals crystallize out of the fluid and build the chimney structure ever higher. The probe's lights illuminate this world without sun. The camera pushes slowly toward the vent.

Cinematic craft cinematography, a Japanese swordsmith hammering red-hot tamahagane repeatedly in a dim forge. Every blow throws sparks like fireworks as the glowing bar extends gradually into the profile of a blade. The smith's face is lit red by the fire, his sweat steaming off. The folding and forging bring out a faint damascene pattern. Close-up from the side catching each strike.

Astronomy documentary cinematic style, an observatory dome opening slowly to reveal a sky full of stars. The huge reflecting telescope begins to turn slowly toward its target field. The tube tracks the sky precisely as it rotates. In the control room an astronomer watches a nebula image sharpen on screen. Starlight through the dome slit reflects off the mirror. Interior medium shot.

Cinematic whitewater expedition, a kayaker paddling hard through rapids. The torrent throws the boat up and slams it down, spray burying his upper body completely. He works both arms to hold balance through the boulder-strewn water. A waterfall roars in the distance under a haze of mist. Low-angle tracking from the bank. Slow-motion close-up.

Night documentary cinematic style, families lighting hundreds of candles at family graves during the Day of the Dead in Mexico City. Orange candlelight illuminates marigold wreaths and colored sugar skulls. A grandmother sits beside a headstone, speaking softly to a photograph and stroking its frame. Children chase each other between the candles. The whole cemetery is wrapped in warm light. Slow panning medium shot.

Cinematic survival style, a climber on the blue ice of Everest's south face swinging an ice axe in a blizzard. He wears an oxygen mask and goggles and has to drive each blow into the ice with everything he has. Ice chips fall from above and rattle off his helmet. Below him is a vast drop with cloud churning through it. The rope shakes violently in the wind. Low-angle shot of the climbing from beneath. Close shot.
